metadata.title: Higher-order Godbersen inequality and a characterization of simplices via the face lattice
metadata.abstract: We settle the long-standing Godbersen conjecture that the mixed volume of a convex body of fixed positive volume with its reflection about the origin is maximized precisely by simplices. For the proof, we establish a new characterization of simplices by a natural incidence relation on the face lattice. Moreover, we establish a higher-order generalization of the Godbersen inequality and show that simplices are the only nontrivial equality cases, confirming a conjecture of Schneider from 2000.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 高阶 Godbersen 与 simplex face-lattice
analysis.workSummary: 原 Godbersen 不等式在先前 Kotrbatý–Mouamine 工作中已证明。本篇通过 product-space mixed-volume monotonicity 的等号条件，转化为 mixed-area-measure support、touching cone 和 polar face-lattice incidence；证明该 incidence 即使 face lattice 无穷也刻画 simplex，从而得到一般凸体等号。再在 (Rⁿ)^p 的 diagonal/coordinate embedding 中给高阶 Godbersen 和 Schneider 2000 猜想的等号分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 连接凸体极值与组合 incidence，并推进到高阶混合体积。
analysis.limitations: 一般凸体等号须 full-dimensional 且 1≤k≤n−1；高阶任一 kᵢ=n 或 lower-dimensional 都为 trivial equality，simplex 唯一性只用于非平凡范围。本文原不等式归属既有工作，不能把所有部分都当作首次证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助证明检查、纠正笔误及寻找文献，数学内容来自作者。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.06806v1 · PDF 第 5 页，AI disclosure
